card.title: I Know Your Tells
card.instruction: Use intimate knowledge of habits, moods, and patterns as expertise that lets you diagnose every choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've tapped your cup three times. You're about to ask for money.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm waiting for the tea to cool.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the story you used before the bicycle loan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Actually, I brought the bicycle money back. I've counted it twice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twice means you want me to refuse it, like your rent money. Keep it; I'll make your usual celebratory tea.
